### Priority list

1. **The three testimonial cards** (`#main > div:nth-child(2/3/4)`, ~65,728px² each) — these are the largest, most numerous rendered blocks on the page and together dominate the visible area below the heading; getting their content (avatar + quote) and DOM order exact matters most.
2. **The `<h1>` "What people say"** (46,768px²) — the single largest text element and the first thing seen at the top of the page.
3. **The broken avatar images and their alt text** — confirmed via screenshot that `/avatar-*.jpg` files don't exist in the fixture directory, so the original genuinely renders broken images with only alt text visible (no icon, no Tailwind styling applied anywhere on the page — there is no stylesheet or CDN script in the source at all). Reproducing this literal unstyled/broken appearance is more faithful than "fixing" it by wiring up a working Tailwind build.

Given the raw HTML is already the entire page (no JS-gated content, confirmed complete), and it references zero stylesheets despite carrying Tailwind-looking class names, the original renders as plain unstyled browser-default HTML with broken image placeholders. I'll clone it as literally as possible rather than "fixing" it with a working Tailwind CDN, since that would visually diverge from the real rendered original.
